name: गणेश पूजा
description: Kise bhi naye kaam ki shuruaat se pehle Vighnaharta Shri Ganesh ki puja ki jati hai. Yah puja karya mein aane wali sabhi badhaon ko door karti hai aur safalta dilaati hai.
whenToPerform: Any auspicious day, Chaturthi, Wednesday, before any new undertaking
vidhiSteps: 1. Pavitrikaran: Hath mein jal lekar 'Om Pavitroya Pavitro Vaa' padhte hue aasan aur swayam par chhidken.
2. Aachaman: 3 baar jal piyein aur 4th baar hath dho lein.
3. Sankalp: Hath mein jal, chawal, pushpa aur dakshina lekar puja ka sankalp lein.
4. Asan Sthapana: Ek patte par laal kapda bichha kar Ganesh ji ki murti sthapit karein.
5. Aavahan: Ganesh ji ka dhyan karte hue unhe puja mein aamantrit karein.
6. Snan: Murti ko pehle jal, phir panchamrit, aur phir shuddh jal se snan karayein.
7. Shringar: Vastra pehnayein, janeu arpit karein, aur sindoor ka tilak lagayein.
8. Pushpa aur Durva: Lal phool aur 21 durva dalein Ganesh ji ko chadhaein.
9. Bhog: Modak, laddoo aur ritufal ka bhog lagayein.
10. Aarti: Kapur aur deepak se Ganesha ki aarti utarein aur kshama prarthana karein.
mantras: Vakratunda Mahakaya Suryakoti Samaprabha, Nirvighnam Kuru Me Deva Sarva Karyeshu Sarvada

name: लक्ष्मी पूजा
description: Mata Lakshmi dhan aur samriddhi ki devi hain. Inki puja se ghar mein sukh, shanti aur dhan ki aavok badhti hai aur garibi door hoti hai.
whenToPerform: Diwali, Fridays, Purnima (especially Sharad Purnima), Dhanteras
vidhiSteps: 1. Sthan Shuddhi: Puja sthan ko saaf karke Gangajal chhidken aur rangoli banayein.
2. Chowki Sthapana: Ek chowki par laal kapda bichhayein aur Ganesh-Lakshmi sthapit karein.
3. Kalash Sthapana: Jal, chawal, aur sikka daalkar kalash sthapit karein. Us par nariyal rakhein.
4. Ganesh Pujan: Sabse pehle Ganesh ji ka pujan karein, unhe snan kara ke tilak lagayein.
5. Lakshmi Aavahan: Mata Lakshmi ka dhyan karein aur unka aavahan karein.
6. Snan aur Vastra: Mata ko panchamrit snan aur naye vastra arpit karein.
7. Shringar: Roli, sindoor, haldi aur kamal ke phool Mata ko arpit karein.
8. Dhan Pujan: Paise ya chandi ke sikkon ki puja karein, un par roli aur akshat chhidken.
9. Bhog: Kheel, batashe aur mithaio ka bhog lagayein.
10. Aarti: Mata Lakshmi ki aarti (Om Jai Lakshmi Mata) gaayein aur prasad baantein.

name: सरस्वती पूजा
description: Vidhya, kala aur gyaan ki devi Maa Saraswati ki puja vidhyarthiyo aur kalakaro ke liye vishesh mahatva rakhti hai. Yah agyanta door karti hai.
whenToPerform: Vasant Panchami, Navami of Navratri
vidhiSteps: 1. Pavitrikaran: Jal se aachaman aur asan shuddhi karein.
2. Sthapana: Ek patte par peela kapda bichhayein aur Maa Saraswati ki photo rakhein.
3. Kitab Pujan: Apni kitabein, pen, ya sangeet ke vadya yantra Mata ke paas rakhein.
4. Sankalp aur Aavahan: Hath mein peele chawal aur jal lekar dhyan karein.
5. Snan: Mata ko snan karayein aur pavitra jal chhidken.
6. Vastra: Peela vastra ya chunari Mata ko udayein.
7. Tilak: Peela chandan ya kesar aur haldi ka tilak Mata aur apni kitabo par lagayein.
8. Pushpa: Peele phool (Jaise gende ke) Mata ko chadhayein.
9. Naivedya: Peele mithe chawal, boondi ya peeli mithai ka bhog lagayein.
10. Aarti: Saraswati vandana karein aur kapur se aarti karein.

name: शिव पूजा / रुद्राभिषेक
description: Mahadev ki kripa paane aur sabhi sankaton se mukti ke liye Rudrabhishek kiya jata hai. Yah grah dosh aur shatru badha door karne mein atyant shaktishali hai.
whenToPerform: Mondays, Maha Shivaratri, Sawan Month, Pradosh Vrat
vidhiSteps: 1. Aachaman aur Sankalp: Shuddhi aur manokamna bol kar sankalp lein.
2. Ganesh-Gauri Pujan: Pehle Ganesh ji aur Mata Parvati ki samanya puja karein.
3. Nandi Pujan: Shiv ji ke vahan Nandi aur nag devta ko jal chadhayein.
4. Abhishek Prarambh: Shivling ko ek thali ya patra mein sthapit karein.
5. Panchamrit Snan: Rudra Ashtadhyayi ke mantro ke sath dudh, dahi, ghee, shahad, chini se abhishek karein.
6. Jal/Gangajal Abhishek: Nirantar jal ki dhara girate hue 'Om Namah Shivaya' ka jaap karein.
7. Shringar: Bhasma ya chandan ka tripund lagayein aur janeu pehnayein.
8. Arpan: 108 Belpatra, dhatura aur aak ke pushpa chadhayein.
9. Bhog: Fal, mithaai ya kheer ka bhog lagayein.
10. Aarti: Shiv ji ki aarti karein aur shanti paath karein.

name: सत्यनारायण कथा
description: Bhagwan Vishnu ke Satyanarayan roop ki puja aur unki varta sunna. Yah ghar mein shanti, samriddhi aur parivar mein prem banaye rakhne ke liye ki jati hai.
whenToPerform: Purnima (Full Moon), Ekadashi, Griha Pravesh, Marriages, or any happy occasion
vidhiSteps: 1. Pavitrikaran aur Sankalp: Puja ka sankalp lekar sthan shuddhi karein.
2. Mandap aur Kalash: Kele ke patto se mandap sajayein, usme kalash sthapit karein.
3. Navgraha aur Ganesh Puja: Navgraha mandal banakar aur Ganesh ji ka aavahan karein.
4. Satyanarayan Sthapana: Bhagwan Vishnu ki photo sthapit karein.
5. Snan aur Shringar: Bhagwan ko panchamrit snan aur peele vastra arpit karein.
6. Pujan aur Tulsi: Pushpa, chandan aur tulsi patra chadhayein (Bina Tulsi ke Vishnu puja adhuri hai).
7. Katha Vachan: Satyanarayan Bhagwan ki katha ke 5 adhyay ka path karein/sune.
8. Bhog/Naivedya: Panjiri, kele aur panchamrit ka bhog lagayein.
9. Aarti: Satyanarayan bhagwan ki aarti (Om Jai Jagdish Hare) gaayein.
10. Prasad Vitaran: Sabhi bhakto mein panjiri aur panchamrit baantein.

name: हवन/यज्ञ (सामान्य)
description: Agni ke madhyam se devtaon ko aahuti pradan karna Havan kehlata hai. Yah vatavaran aur aatma dono ko shuddh karne ke liye kiya jata hai.
whenToPerform: Completion of any big puja, Navratri, Griha Pravesh, Birthdays
vidhiSteps: 1. Kund Sthapana: Havan kund ko shuddh sthan par rakhein aur aspas roli se swastik banayein.
2. Agni Prajwalan: Kapur aur sukhi lakdi se Agni Dev ka aavahan karte hue aag jalayein.
3. Achaman aur Sankalp: Shuddhikaran karke havan ka sankalp lein.
4. Ganesh & Navgraha Aahuti: Sabse pehle 'Om Ganapataye Swaha' bolkar Ganesh ji, phir Navgraho ki aahutiyan dein.
5. Mool Mantra Aahuti: Jis devta ka havan ho raha hai, unke mool mantra ke sath samagri aur ghee ki aahuti (Swaha) dein.
6. Gayatri Mantra: Gayatri mantra padhkar aahuti dein.
7. Mahamrityunjaya Aahuti: 'Om Trayambakam...' bolkar swasthya ke liye aahuti dein.
8. Sruva Aahuti: Sirf ghee ki aahutiyan devtaon ke naamon se dein.
9. Purnaahuti: Ek nariyal mein roli lapetkar, havan samagri aur ghee ke sath aakhiri aahuti ('Om Purnamadah...' bolkar) dein.
10. Bhasma Dharan: Agni shant hone par havan ki rakh (bhasma) ko mathe par lagayein.

name: नवग्रह शांति
description: Kundli mein sthit navgraho ki shanti aur dushprabhav ko kam karne ke liye yeh puja hoti hai. Isse jeevan mein aane wale kasht door hote hain.
whenToPerform: During Graha Dosh, Amavasya, Eclipse, before auspicious ceremonies
vidhiSteps: 1. Sankalp: Apne naam aur gotra ke sath kundli ke grah dosh nivaran ka sankalp lein.
2. Navgraha Mandal: Chawal, urad, moong aadi 9 anaajo se Navgraha mandal banayein.
3. Kalash Sthapana: Har grah ke liye kalash sthapit karein aur unke rang ke anusar vastra pehnayein.
4. Aavahan: Surya se shuru karke Ketu tak sabhi 9 graho ka aavahan karein.
5. Shodashopachara Puja: Sabhi graho ko snan, vastra, chandan, aur pushpa arpit karein.
6. Mantra Jaap: Har grah ka vedic ya beej mantra nishchit sankhya mein jaap karein (Pandit dwara).
7. Havan: Navgraho ki specific lakdiyo (Samidha) aur ghee se havan karein.
8. Graha Aahuti: 'Om Suryaya Swaha', 'Om Chandraya Swaha' aadi mantro ke sath aahuti dein.
9. Daan: Surya ke liye gehu/gud, Shani ke liye tel/kaale til aadi ka daan karein.
10. Aarti aur Shanti Path: Aarti karke Ved pathi brahmano se shanti aashirwad lein.

name: महामृत्युंजय जाप
description: Ghor sankat, lambi bimari, ya akal mrityu ke bhay se bachne ke liye Shiv ji ka yeh maha shaktishali jaap karvaya jata hai.
whenToPerform: During severe illness, bad planetary dashas, Mondays
vidhiSteps: 1. Sankalp: Rogi ke parijan ya rogi swayam naam aur gotra lekar 1.25 lakh jaap ka sankalp lete hain.
2. Shiv Sthapana: Shivling sthapit karke unka panchamrit abhishek karein.
3. Pujan: Belpatra, dhatura aur bhasma arpit karke vidhivat pujan karein.
4. Brahmano Dwara Jaap: 5 ya 11 pandit rozaana Rudraksha ki mala se Mahamrityunjaya mantra ka jaap shuru karte hain.
5. Niyamit Abhishek: Jaap ke dauran roz shivling par jal/dugdha abhishek hota rehta hai.
6. Jaap Sankhya: Sankalp ki hui jaap sankhya ko nishchit dino mein pura kiya jata hai.
7. Dashansh Havan: Jaap pura hone ke baad kul jaap ka 10% (Dashansh) havan kiya jata hai.
8. Purnaahuti: Havan ki aakhiri aahuti dekar agni dev aur Shiv ji ko pranam karein.
9. Brahman Bhojan: Pandit ji ko bhojan karayein aur dakshina dein.
10. Bhasma Dharan: Havan ki vibhuti rogi ke mathe par lagayein.
mantras: Om Tryambakam Yajamahe Sugandhim Pushti-Vardhanam Urvarukamiva Bandhanan Mrityormukshiya Mamritat

name: सुंदरकांड पाठ
description: Ramcharitmanas ke Sundarkand mein Hanuman ji ke bal aur bhakti ka varnan hai. Iska path har prakar ke sankat, dar aur nakaratmakta ko door karta hai.
whenToPerform: Tuesdays, Saturdays, Chaitra Navratri, Hanuman Jayanti
vidhiSteps: 1. Sthan Shuddhi: Puja sthan ki safaai karein aur lal kapda bichhayein.
2. Sthapana: Shri Ram parivar aur Hanuman ji ki pratima/photo sthapit karein.
3. Sankalp: Path ka uddeshya man mein rakhkar sankalp lein.
4. Pujan: Hanuman ji ko sindoor aur chameli ka tel (Chola) chadhayein.
5. Ganesh & Ram Stuti: Path shuru karne se pehle Ganesh vandana aur Ram Stuti (Shri Ramachandra Kripalu) gaayein.
6. Path Prarambh: 'Jamvant ke bachan suhaye...' se Sundarkand ka path sushwar shuru karein.
7. Hanuman Chalisa: Sundarkand purn hone par Hanuman Chalisa aur Bajrang Baan ka path karein.
8. Bhog: Besan ke laddoo ya boondi ka bhog tulsi dal rakhkar lagayein.
9. Aarti: Hanuman ji ki aarti (Aarti Kije Hanuman Lala ki) gaayein.
10. Prasad Vitaran: Sabhi shrotao ko prasad baantein.
mantras: Ram Rameti Rameti, Rame Rame Manorame...

name: हनुमान पूजा
description: Bhoot-pishach, bhay, aur bimariyon se raksha ke liye Bajrangbali ki puja ki jati hai. Yah bal, buddhi aur vidhya pradan karti hai.
whenToPerform: Tuesdays, Saturdays, Hanuman Jayanti
vidhiSteps: 1. Aachaman: Pavitra hokar lal aasan par baithein.
2. Dhyan: 'Ram Dootam' roop mein Hanuman ji ka dhyan karein.
3. Snan aur Chola: Murti ko jal se snan kara ke sindoor mein chameli tel milakar chola chadhayein.
4. Vastra: Lal langot ya lal vastra pehnayein.
5. Pushpa: Lal kaner ya gulab ke phool aur mala chadhayein.
6. Bhog: Gur, bhune chane, aur besan ke laddoo ka bhog (tulsi dalkar) lagayein.
7. Jaap: 'Om Ham Hanumate Namah' ki ek mala jaap karein.
8. Chalisa Path: Hanuman Chalisa ya Sankat Mochan Ashtak ka path karein.
9. Aarti: Kapur jalakar Hanuman ji aur Ram ji ki aarti karein.
10. Prarthana: Apne sankato ko door karne ki prarthana karein.
mantras: Om Ham Hanumate Rudratmakaya Hum Phat

name: दुर्गा सप्तशती पाठ
description: Markandeya Purana ka ek hissa jisme Maa Durga dwara asuron ke vadh ka varnan hai. Iske 700 shloko ka path shatru nash, shakti aur manokamna purti ke liye karte hain.
whenToPerform: Navratri, Ashtami, Chaturdashi
vidhiSteps: 1. Pavitrikaran aur Sankalp: Shuddhi aur manokamna ko dhyan mein rakh kar sankalp karein.
2. Kalash Sthapana: Jau dalkar mitti ka kalash sthapit karein (Navratri mein).
3. Devi Aavahan: Mata ko chunari udayein, roli lagayein aur lal phool chadhayein.
4. Shaap Vimochan: Saptashati path se pehle kitabo ke shaapoddhar mantras padhein.
5. Kavach, Argala, Keelak: Path shuru karne se pehle in teeno stotro ka path karein.
6. Navarna Mantra Jaap: 'Om Aim Hreem Kleem Chamundayai Vichche' ki mala japein.
7. Saptashati Path: 13 Adhyayo (Chapters) ka path vidhivat karein.
8. Kunjika Stotram: Path ke ant mein Siddha Kunjika Stotra padhein.
9. Bhog: Halwa, chana aur puri ka bhog Mata ko arpit karein.
10. Havan aur Aarti: Path sampann hone par saptashati ke mantro se havan aur phir Mata ki aarti karein.
mantras: Om Aim Hreem Kleem Chamundayai Vichche
Sarva Mangala Mangalye Shive Sarvartha Sadhike

name: राम कथा
description: Bhagwan Ram ke aadarsh jeevan, charitra aur leelaon ka gun-gaan Ram Katha kehlata hai. Yah samaj mein maryada, prem aur dharm ki sthapana karti hai.
whenToPerform: Ram Navami, Diwali, or any auspicious week
samagriList: Vyas Peeth (Elevated seat for the narrator)
vidhiSteps: 1. Kalash Yatra: Katha shuru hone se pehle gaon/mohalle mein kalash yatra nikali jati hai.
2. Vyas Peeth Pujan: Katha vachak (Vyas) aur Ramcharitmanas granth ka pujan hota hai.
3. Sankalp: Mukhya yajman katha shravan ka sankalp lete hain.
4. Daily Pujan: Har roz katha shuru hone se pehle Ram ji ka samanya pujan aur aarti hoti hai.
5. Katha Vachan: Vyas ji gaakar aur samjhakar Ram ji ke janm se lekar rajyabhishek tak katha sunate hain.
6. Utsav Manana: Janmotsav, Vivah, aadi prasango par vishesh jhankiyan aur bhajan hote hain.
7. Vishram: Roz katha ke ant mein prabhu ko vishram diya jata hai.
8. Aarti aur Prasad: Niyamit roop se Ram ji ki aarti hoti hai aur bhakto mein prasad bant-ta hai.
9. Havan: Katha ke aakhiri din Ramcharitmanas ke mantro se Purnaahuti havan hota hai.
10. Bhandara: Havan ke baad sabhi bhakto ke liye vishal bhandare ka aayojan hota hai.
mantras: Shri Ram, Jai Ram, Jai Jai Ram

name: भागवत कथा
description: Shrimad Bhagwat Mahapuran ka saptahik (7 din) path. Yah katha moksha dayini mani jati hai aur bhakto mein prem aur bhakti ka sanchar karti hai.
whenToPerform: Pitru Paksha, Kartik month, or in memory of departed souls for moksha
vidhiSteps: 1. Shobha Yatra: Poth (Book) ki shobha yatra nikal kar katha sthal tak laya jata hai.
2. Mahatmya Path: Pehle din Bhagwat ke mahatmya (importance) ka path hota hai.
3. Shukdev-Parikshit Samvad: Raja Parikshit ko moksha dilane ke liye Shukdev ji ne yeh katha sunayi thi, usi bhao se aagaz hota hai.
4. Daily Pujan: Shaligram ji aur Bhagwat pustak ki tulsi-dal aur pushpo se niyamit puja.
5. Krishna Janmotsav: Katha ke beech Krishna janm par vishesh utsav manaya jata hai.
6. Leela Varnan: Govardhan puja, Raas Leela aur Rukmini Vivah ko jhanki sahit manaya jata hai.
7. Makhan Bhog: Rozana bhagwan ko makhan aur mishri ka bhog lagta hai.
8. Uddhav Gita aur Moksha: 7ve din Krishna ke swadham gaman aur Parikshit moksha ka varnan hota hai.
9. Havan (Gita Path): 108 aahutiyo ke sath havan kiya jata hai.
10. Purnima/Bhandara: Vyas pujan, daan aur vishal bhandare ke sath vishram hota hai.

name: गृह प्रवेश पूजा
description: Naye ghar mein pehli baar pravesh karne par vastu shanti, nishkasan aur navgraha shanti ke liye yah puja ki jati hai.
whenToPerform: Auspicious Muhurat based on Nakshatra, typically Vasant Panchami, Akshaya Tritiya, Dusshera
vidhiSteps: 1. Dwar Pujan: Ghar ke main gate ko saaf karke toran bandhein aur swastik banayein.
2. Peeli Sarson: Buri shaktiyo ko dur karne ke liye ghar mein peeli sarson chhidken.
3. Mangal Kalash Pravesh: Ghar ki mukhya mahila sir par jal-bhara kalash aur nariyal lekar ghar mein dahina pair aage rakhkar pravesh karti hai.
4. Gau Pravesh: Yadi sambhav ho to cow ko ghar ke andar ghumaya jata hai.
5. Ganesh & Navgraha Pujan: Aangan ya hall mein chowki lagakar Ganesh ji aur navgraho ki sthapana aur puja karein.
6. Vastu Purush Pujan: Vastu devta ko prasan karne ke liye unki aahuti aur pujan karein.
7. Havan: Vastu, Navgraha aur shanti mantro se ghar mein havan karein taki dhua pure ghar mein faile.
8. Milk Boiling: Naye ghar ke kitchen mein naye bartan mein chawal aur gud daalkar dudh ubalein jab tak ki vah ufan kar bahar na gire (samriddhi ka pratik).
9. Bhog: Usi ubale hue dudh (kheer) ka bhog lagayein.
10. Brahman Bhojan: Pandit ji ko dakshina dein aur bhojan karayein.
benefits: Invites peace and prosperity to the new house

name: वास्तु शांति
description: Ghar ya building bante samay hui vastu-dosh (architectural errors) ko theek karne aur Vastu Purush ko shant karne ke liye Vastu Shanti pujan hota hai.
whenToPerform: Before Griha Pravesh, or when experiencing constant trouble in an existing house
vidhiSteps: 1. Sthan Pavitrikaran: Pure bhawan mein panchakgavya (gaumutra aadi) chhidken.
2. Sankalp: Vastu dosh nivaran ka sankalp lein.
3. Vastu Mandal Sthapana: 64 ya 81 pado (squares) wala Vastu mandal banayein.
4. Aavahan: Mandal par Vastu Purush aur dishaon ke swami (Dikpala) ka aavahan karein.
5. Shodashopachara Pujan: Vastu devta ki vidhivat puja karein aur bali (Urad dal, dahi) arpit karein.
6. Navgraha Shanti: Vastu dosh graho se bhi juda hota hai, isliye navgraha puja karein.
7. Havan: Vastu Suktam aur raksha mantro se havan kund mein aahuti dein.
8. Vastu Pratima Sthapana: Puja ki hui Vastu murti ko ghar ki neev ya ishan kon mein dafen karein/sthapit karein.
9. Purnaahuti: Havan purn karke aarti karein.
10. Brahmano se Aashirwad: Pandit ji aur ghar ke bado se ashirwad lein.

name: विवाह / शादी
deity: All major Hindu Deities, Agni Dev
description: Hindu dharma ke 16 sanskaro mein se ek, jisme do aatmao aur parivaro ka milan hota hai. Agni ko sakshi mankar sat phere liye jate hain.
whenToPerform: Vivah Muhurat (Shubh Lagna) calculated via Kundli
vidhiSteps: 1. Dwar Puja: Barat aane par swagat aur dwar pujan hota hai.
2. Jaimala: Var (Groom) aur Vadhu (Bride) ek dusre ko pushpa mala pehnate hain.
3. Kanyadaan: Vadhu ke pita apna dahina hath var ke hath mein dekar kanya ka daan karte hain.
4. Gathbandhan: Var ke dupatte aur vadhu ki chunari ko bandha jata hai.
5. Havan & Agni Sthapana: Pavitra agni prajwalit kar navgraha aur prajapati ko aahuti di jati hai.
6. Laja Homa: Vadhu ka bhai lava (kheel) deta hai, jise var-vadhu milkar agni mein dalte hain.
7. Saptapadi (7 Phere): Var-vadhu agni ke 7 chakkar lagate hain, har phere ke sath ek vachan lete hain.
8. Shilarohan: Vadhu apna pair patthar par rakhti hai (pahaad jaisi majbuti ke liye).
9. Sindoor Daan aur Mangalsutra: Var, vadhu ki maang mein sindoor bharta hai aur mangalsutra pehnata hai.
10. Ashirwad: Vivah sampann hone par bado se aur brahmano se ashirwad liya jata hai.

name: मुंडन संस्कार
description: Bacche ke janm ke baad uske pehle baal utarne ki pratha. Ise pichle janm ke runo aur ashuddhiyo se mukti ka pratik mana jata hai.
whenToPerform: Usually 1st, 3rd, or 5th year of the child (Odd years)
vidhiSteps: 1. Ganesh aur Kuldevi Pujan: Bacche ko naye kapde pehnakar Ganesh ji aur apne Kuldevta ki puja shuru karein.
2. Sankalp: Mata-pita bacche ke swasthya aur lambi umar ke liye sankalp lete hain.
3. Havan: Pavitra agni jalakar navgraha aur aayu (longevity) ke liye mantro se aahuti dein.
4. Barber (Nai) ka Pujan: Baal katne wale nai ka aadar-pujan karein aur uske aupcharik auzaro ko pavitra karein.
5. Pratham Baal Katna: Pandit ji ya parivar ka mukhiya vedic mantro ke sath 3-5 baal pehle kat-te hain.
6. Mundan (Shaving): Uske baad nai bacche ka pura sir mundan karta hai (shikha/choti chhodkar).
7. Haldi-Chandan Lep: Kate hue sir par thandak ke liye haldi aur chandan ka lep lagaya jata hai.
8. Snan: Bacche ko nahlakar naye vastra pehnaye jate hain.
9. Visarjan: Kate hue baalo ko gunde hue aate (dough) mein rakhkar kisi pavitra nadi mein visarjit kiya jata hai.
10. Aarti aur Ashirwad: Puja ki purnaahuti karke brahman aur bado se bacche ke liye ashirwad lein.

name: नामकरण संस्कार
description: Bacche ka vidhivat naam rakhne ka samaroh. Jyotish ke anusar nakshatra dekh kar bacche ko uska pehchaan (naam) diya jata hai.
whenToPerform: 11th or 12th day after birth
vidhiSteps: 1. Sutak Nivaran: 11ve din tak ghar mein sutak mana jata hai, namkaran ke din jal chhidak kar ghar ki shuddhi hoti hai.
2. Snan aur Vastra: Bacche aur mata-pita ko snan kara ke naye pavitra kapde pehnaye jate hain.
3. Ganesh aur Graha Shanti Pujan: Ganesh ji ki sthapana karke navgraho ki puja aur havan kiya jata hai.
4. Nakshatra Pujan: Baccha jis nakshatra mein paida hua hai, us devta ki puja hoti hai.
5. Chawal par Naam Likhna: Ek thali mein chawal failakar uspar soney (gold) ki angoothi ya kush (ghas) se bacche ka naam likha jata hai.
6. Kaan mein Naam Uchharan: Bua (father's sister) ya pita bacche ke daahine kaan mein 3 baar 'Tumhara naam (Naam) hai' kahte hain.
7. Madhu Prasan: Bacche ki jeebh par thoda sa shahad lagaya jata hai (taki uski vaani meethi ho).
8. Surya aur Chandra Darshan: Bacche ko bahar la kar Surya dev ya Chandra dev ke darshan karaye jate hain.
9. Aarti: Bhagwan ki aarti aur dhanyavad prarthana karein.
10. Brahman Bhojan aur Daan: Pandit ji ko vastra aur dakshina dekar vidayi karein aur meethai baantein.
mantras: Om Ashmabhav Parashur Bhaav... (Blessing for strength and intellect)

name: अन्नप्राशन
description: Jab bacche ko pehli baar maa ke doodh ke alawa thos aahaar (solid food) khilaya jata hai. Yah aayu aur bal ki vriddhi ke liye hota hai.
whenToPerform: 6th month for boys, 5th or 7th month for girls
samagriList: Items for future-choice game (Book, Pen, Gold, Clay/Soil, Knife)
vidhiSteps: 1. Pujan Prarambh: Mata-pita bacche ko godh mein lekar Ganesh ji aur Annapurna Mata ki puja karte hain.
2. Havan: Bacche ki pachan shakti (digestive fire) acchi rahe isliye agni me aahuti di jati hai.
3. Kheer Nirman: Chawal, doodh, shakkar aur thoda ghee/shahad milakar pavitra kheer banayi jati hai.
4. Naivedya: Pehle is kheer ka bhog bhagwan ko lagaya jata hai.
5. Annaprashan (Feeding): Chandi ki katori-chammach se pita ya mama bacche ko pehli baar kheer khilate hain.
6. Mantrocchar: Mantro ke dwara prarthana ki jati hai ki yah anna bacche ke sharir ko bal pradan kare.
7. Bhavishya Darshan Khel: Bacche ke samne Kitab (Gyaan), Sona (Dhan), Mitti (Sampatti/Kheti) aur Pen (Vidya) rakhe jate hain.
8. Bacche ka Chunav: Baccha inme se jo sabse pehle uthata hai, uski ruchi us kshetra mein mani jati hai.
9. Ashirwad: Parivar ke bade buzurg bacche ko uphaar aur ashirwad dete hain.
10. Aarti: Purn aarti kar sabhi ko aahar (kheer) prasad ke roop mein diya jata hai.

name: उपनयन / जनेऊ संस्कार
description: Yagyopavit ya Janeu sanskar ek vidhyarthi ke aadhayatmik shiksha ke aarambh ka pratik hai. Isse balak ka 'Dusra Janm' (Dvija) mana jata hai.
whenToPerform: Ages 7 to 11 (Varies by Varna), Vasant Panchami
vidhiSteps: 1. Mundan aur Snan: Balak ka mundan (shikha ko chhodkar) karke shuddh snan karaya jata hai.
2. Pujan aur Havan: Ganesh, navgraha puja aur havan kiya jata hai.
3. Kopin aur Vastra: Balak ko samanya kapde chhodkar brahmachari ke peele vastra pehnaye jate hain.
4. Yagyopavit Dharan: Guru/Pandit mantro ke sath balak ko baaye kandhe se daahine kamar tak janeu pehnate hain.
5. Surya Darshan: Balak ko bahar Surya dev ke darshan aur jal arpit karvaya jata hai.
6. Gayatri Mantra Updesh: Guru ek kapde se dhak kar balak ke kaan mein pahli baar Gayatri Mantra ka updesh dete hain.
7. Danda aur Mekhala: Balak ko hath mein palash ka danda aur kamar par moonj ki mekhala bandhi jati hai.
8. Bhiksha-atan: Balak apne guru ke liye apni maa, behan, aur anya rishtedaro se pehli 'Bhiksha' (daan) maangta hai ('Bhavati Bhiksham Dehi').
9. Vidayi ka Naatak: Balak sanyasi ban kar Kashi padhne jaane ka natak karta hai, jise mama mana kar wapas late hain.
10. Purnaahuti: Havan aur aarti ke sath puja purn hoti hai.

name: श्राद्ध / पितृ पूजा
description: Apne poorvajo (ancestors) ki shanti, unka aashirwad pane aur unke prati kritagyata vyakt karne ke liye Shradh karma kiya jata hai.
whenToPerform: Pitru Paksha (Mahalaya), Death Anniversary (Tithi), Amavasya
vidhiSteps: 1. Pavitrikaran: Hath mein kusha aur jal lekar aachaman aur shuddhi karein.
2. Sankalp: Apne pitru ka naam aur gotra bolkar shradh ka sankalp lein.
3. Tarpan: Kusha ghas, chawal, aur kaale til mishrit jal se Dakshin (South) disha ki or mukh karke pitruo ko jal arpit karein.
4. Agniyaukaran (Havan): Kande/upale ki aag par kheer aur ghee ki aahuti dein.
5. Pind Daan: Uble hue chawal, jau ke aate aur til se Pind banakar unki puja karein aur pitruo ko samarpit karein.
6. Panchbali Bhog: Khana nikal kar 5 jagah rakhein - Cow, Kutta, Kauwa, Devta, aur Chitiyo (Ants) ke liye.
7. Brahman Bhojan: Pandit ji ko aadar sahit khana khilayein.
8. Daan-Dakshina: Brahman ko vastra, chata, jute (shoes), anna aur dakshina dein.
9. Tilanjali: Hath mein jal aur til lekar Pind ke upar chhoden.
10. Prarthana: Jane-anjane mein hui bhool ki kshama mangein aur unka ashirwad maange.
mantras: Om Devatabhyah Pitrubhyashcha Mahayogibhya Eva Cha...

name: पिंड दान
description: Mritatma ko is lok ke bandhan se mukt karke parlok (Vaikuntha) bhejney ke liye Gaya (Bihar) ya kisi pavitra teerth par Pind Daan kiya jata hai.
whenToPerform: Gaya Tirth, Kashi, Pushkar, Badrinath, or During Pitru Paksha
vidhiSteps: 1. Teerth Snan: Kisi pavitra nadi (Jaise Falgu nadi, Gaya mein) mein snan karke shuddh vastra pehnein.
2. Vishnu Smaran: Bhagwan Vishnu aur Yama devta ka dhyan karein.
3. Pind Nirman: Jau/chawal ke aate ko shahad, doodh aur til mila kar gol Pind (balls) banayein.
4. Kusha Aasan: Zameen par kusha ghas bichha kar us par pind sthapit karein.
5. Pind Pujan: Pindo par safed phool, chandan, aur jal arpit karein.
6. Naam Gotra Uchcharan: Apne guzar chuke mata/pita/purvajo ka naam aur gotra bol kar pind daan karein.
7. Tarpan: Kaale til aur jal se tarpan karein.
8. Prarthana: 'Hamare pitru is aahar se tript ho aur hume aashirwad dein' aisi prarthana karein.
9. Visarjan: Puja ke baad in pindo ko pavitra nadi ke jal mein pravahit kar dein.
10. Brahman Bhojan: Tirth sthan par teerth-purohit ko bhojan kara kar dakshina dein.
mantras: Mantra related to specific Pind Daan chapters in Garuda Purana

name: काल सर्प दोष शांति
description: Jab kundali mein saare grah Rahu aur Ketu ke beech aa jate hain to Kaal Sarp dosh banta hai. Iske nivaran ke liye vishesh Nag puja aur Rudrabhishek kiya jata hai.
whenToPerform: Naag Panchami, Amavasya, Trimbakeshwar (Nashik), Ujjain
vidhiSteps: 1. Sankalp: Nadi kinare ya Shiv mandir mein dosh nivaran ka sankalp lein.
2. Shiv Puja: Sabse pehle Bhagwan Shiv ka panchamrit se Rudrabhishek karein.
3. Naag Sthapana: Chandi ke Naag-Naagin jode ko ek thali mein sthapit karein.
4. Rahu-Ketu Puja: Rahu aur Ketu ke mantro ka jaap pandito dwara kiya jata hai.
5. Naag Pujan: Naag devta ko doodh arpit karein, chandan lagayein aur phool chadhayein.
6. Havan: Kaal Sarp dosh nivaran mantro ke sath samidha aur ghee se havan karein.
7. Purnaahuti: Havan pura karke kshama prarthana karein.
8. Naag Visarjan: Chandi ke Naag-Naagin ko bahate jal (nadi) mein pravahit kar dein ya mandir mein daan karein.
9. Vastra Daan: Kale aur safed vastra (Rahu-Ketu ke rang) greebo ko daan karein.
10. Aarti: Ant mein Mahadev ki aarti karke ashirwad lein.
mantras: Om Navakullaya Vidmahe Vishadantaya Dheemahi Tanno Sarpah Prachodayat
benefits: Removes obstacles in career and marriage

name: मंगल दोष शांति
description: Manglik dosh vivah mein badha aur klesh ka karan banta hai. Bhat Puja (Ujjain) ya Kumbh Vivah iske prabhav ko nasht karne ke liye kiya jata hai.
whenToPerform: Tuesdays, Mangalnath Mandir (Ujjain), Before marriage
vidhiSteps: 1. Sankalp: Mangal dosh shanti aur sukhad vaivahik jeevan ka sankalp.
2. Mangal Sthapana: Mangal yantra ya mitti ki murti ko lal kapde par rakhein.
3. Bhat Pujan (Ujjain special): Uble hue chawal (Bhat) se Mangal devta (Shiv roop) ka shringar kiya jata hai.
4. Snan: Rakt chandan milakar jal se snan karayein.
5. Shringar aur Arpan: Lal phool, kumkum aur masoor ki dal arpit karein.
6. Jaap: 'Om Kram Kreem Kroum Sah Bhaumaya Namah' ka jaap (10,000 bar).
7. Kumbh Vivah (Optional): Yadi kanya/var ati-manglik hai to uska vivah pehle ghade (Kumbh), Peepal vriksh ya Vishnu murti se karaya jata hai.
8. Havan: Mangal mantro ke sath havan karein.
9. Daan: Tamabe (Copper) ka bartan, masoor dal, gud aur lal vastra daan karein.
10. Aarti: Aarti aur shanti path ke baad puja sampann karein.
mantras: Om Kram Kreem Kroum Sah Bhaumaya Namah
Dharani Garbha Sambhutam Vidyut Kanti Samaprabham...

name: बगलामुखी पूजा
description: Das Mahavidya mein se ek, Maa Baglamukhi dushmano ka stambhan (paralyze) karne, court cases jitne aur buri shaktiyo se bachav ke liye puji jati hain.
whenToPerform: Ashtami, Chaturdashi, Navami, Amavasya, Thursdays
vidhiSteps: 1. Niyam aur Aasan: Is puja mein sab kuch peela (yellow) hona chahiye. Peela vastra pehan kar peele aasan par baithein.
2. Sankalp: Shatru nash ya mukadme mein vijay ka vishesh sankalp lein.
3. Yantra Sthapana: Ek chowki par peela kapda bichha kar Baglamukhi Yantra sthapit karein.
4. Bhairav Puja: Maa ke sath Mrityunjaya Bhairav ki puja anivarya hai.
5. Aavahan: Maa Pitambara ka dhyan karein aur aavahan karein.
6. Peeli Samagri Arpan: Maa ko peele phool, peeli haldi, peela chandan aur peeli chunari arpit karein.
7. Mantra Jaap: Haldi ki mala se 'Om Hleem Baglamukhi...' mantra ka 36000 ya 1.25 lakh jaap kiya jata hai (Pandito dwara).
8. Bhog: Besan ke laddoo ya peeli mithai ka bhog lagayein.
9. Havan: Haldi, peeli sarson aur peele phoolo se vishesh havan hota hai.
10. Aarti aur Kshamaprarthana: Aarti ke baad shatruo par vijay prapti ka ashirwad maange.
mantras: Om Hleem Baglamukhi Sarva Dushtanam Vacham Mukham Padam Stambhaya Jihvam Keelaya Buddhim Vinashaya Hleem Om Swaha

name: संतोषी माता व्रत
description: Ghar mein shanti, santosh aur ikshit fal ki prapti ke liye shukrawar ko Santoshi mata ka vrat aur puja ki jati hai. Isme khatti cheezein (sour food) khana sakht mana hai.
whenToPerform: 16 consecutive Fridays
vidhiSteps: 1. Kalash Sthapana: Ek lota (kalash) jal bhar kar us par ek katori rakhein jisme gud aur chana ho.
2. Mata Sthapana: Mata ki photo kalash ke piche rakhein.
3. Pujan: Mata ko roli lagayein, phool chadhayein aur deepak jalayein.
4. Bhog: Gud aur chane ka prasad Mata ko arpit karein.
5. Katha Vachan: Santoshi Mata ki katha padhein ya sunein. Hath mein gud-chana rakhein.
6. Aarti: 'Jai Santoshi Mata' ki aarti gaayein.
7. Prasad Vitaran: Katha sunne walo mein gud-chana baantein.
8. Jal Arpan: Kalash ke bache hue jal ko tulsi ke paudhe mein daal dein.
9. Niyam: Vrat karne wale ko us din khatti cheeze (nimbu, dahi, aamchoor) bilkul nahi khani hai.
10. Udyapan: 16 shukrawar pure hone par 8 bacho ko (jo khatta na khaye) kheer-puri khilakar udyapan karein.
mantras: Ya Devi Sarvabhuteshu Santoshi Rupena Samsthita

name: नवरात्रि पूजा
description: 9 dino tak Maa Durga ke 9 roopo ki puja. Yah burai par acchai ki jeet aur shakti sanchay ka sabse bada tyohar hai.
whenToPerform: Chaitra Navratri (Spring) and Sharadiya Navratri (Autumn)
vidhiSteps: 1. Ghatasthapana (Day 1): Shuddh mitti mein jau boti hain aur us par kalash sthapit karte hain.
2. Kalash Pujan: Kalash mein jal, sikka, supari daalkar aam ke patte aur nariyal (lal kapde mein lapet kar) rakhein.
3. Akhand Jyoti: Mata ke samne 9 din tak lagatar jalne wala deepak (Akhand Jyot) jalayein.
4. Daily Pujan: Har din ek naye roop (Shailputri, Brahmacharini, aadi) ki puja hoti hai.
5. Shringar Arpan: Mata ko bindi, chudi, sindoor, mehendi (solah shringar) chadhayein.
6. Saptashati Path: Rozana Durga Saptashati ya Durga Chalisa ka path karein.
7. Bhog: Har din Mata ke pasand ka alag bhog (jaise makhana, kheer, halwa) lagayein.
8. Aarti: Dhoop aur kapur se subah-sham Mata ki aarti karein.
9. Kanya Pujan (Day 8/9): Ashtami ya Navami ke din 9 chhoti kanyao ko Mata ka roop mankar bhojan karaein aur dakshina dein.
10. Visarjan (Day 10): Dashami ko kalash ka jal pure ghar mein chhidken aur jau (khetri) ko nadi mein visarjit karein.
mantras: Ya Devi Sarva Bhuteshu Shakti Rupena Samsthita...
Om Shreem Hreem Kleem Glaum Gam Ganapataye...

name: छठ पूजा
deity: Surya Dev (Sun God) and Chhathi Maiya
description: Bihar, UP aur Nepal ka mukhya tyohar jisme dhalte aur ugate Surya ko arghya diya jata hai. Yah santan prapti aur lambi aayu ke liye hota hai.
whenToPerform: Kartik Shukla Shashthi (6th day after Diwali)
vidhiSteps: 1. Nahay-Khay (Day 1): Vrati (fasting person) snan karke shuddh bhojan (lauki sabzi, chana dal, chawal) grahan karta hai.
2. Kharna (Day 2): Din bhar nirjala vrat ke baad sham ko rasiyaav (kheer) aur roti ka bhog lagakar Vrati khata hai.
3. Prasad Nirman: Day 3 ki subah thekua aur chawal ke laddoo (kachavaniya) shuddhata se banaye jate hain.
4. Daala Sajana: Baans ke soop aur daub mein saara prasad, fal aur ganna sajaya jata hai.
5. Sandhya Arghya (Day 3): Vrati sham ko nadi/talab mein khade hokar astachalgami (dhalte) Surya ko arghya dete hain.
6. Kosi Bharai: Raat ko aangan mein ganne ka mandap banakar chhathi maiya ke geet gaaye jate hain aur mitti ke hathi/diye jalaye jate hain.
7. Ratri Jagran: Mahilayein raat bhar bhajan gaati hain.
8. Usha Arghya (Day 4): Subah andhere hi nadi tat par phochkar udaygami (ugte) Surya ko arghya diya jata hai.
9. Vrat Paran: Surya ko jal dene ke baad prasad khakar vrati apna nirjala vrat kholte hain.
10. Prasad Vitaran: Sabhi padosiyo aur rishtedaro ko chhath ka pavitra prasad bata jata hai.

name: धन्वंतरि पूजा
description: Ayurveda ke devta aur Vishu ke avatar Bhagwan Dhanvantari ki puja achhe swasthya aur bimariyo se mukti ke liye ki jati hai.
whenToPerform: Dhanteras (Trayodashi before Diwali)
vidhiSteps: 1. Pavitrikaran: Hath mein jal lekar aachaman karein.
2. Sthapana: Ek chowki par Dhanvantari bhagwan ki photo sthapit karein.
3. Kalash: Kalash mein jal aur aushadhi (jadi booti) dalkar rakhein kyunki bhagwan amrit kalash lekar prakat hue the.
4. Aavahan: 'Om Dhanvantaraye Namah' kahkar bhagwan ka dhyan karein.
5. Snan aur Vastra: Jal se snan kara ke peele vastra arpit karein.
6. Pujan: Chandan ka tilak lagayein, phool aur tulsi patra chadhayein.
7. Aushadhi Pujan: Ghar mein rakhi dawaiyo aur aushadhiyo ki bhi puja karein.
8. Mantra Jaap: Dhanvantari Gayatri mantra ka 108 baar jaap karein.
9. Bhog: Prasad aur mithaai ka bhog lagayein.
10. Aarti aur Yam Deep: Dhanvantari aarti karein. Sham ko ghar ke bahar Yamraj ke nam ka choumukha deepak bhi jalayein (Akal mrityu se bachne ke liye).
mantras: Om Namo Bhagavate Maha Sudharshana Vasudevaya Dhanvantaraye...
Om Tat Purushaya Vidmahae Amritha Kalasa Hasthaya Dheemahi Tanno Dhanvantri Prachodayat

name: व्यापार वृद्धि पूजा
description: Business mein tarakki, grahak (customers) badhane aur aarthik nuksan se bachne ke liye naye office ya dukan mein yeh puja ki jati hai.
whenToPerform: Before opening a new shop/office, Diwali, Pushya Nakshatra
vidhiSteps: 1. Shuddhikaran: Dukaan/office ko saaf karke gangajal chhidken.
2. Asan Sthapana: Purab (East) ya Uttar (North) mukh karke chowki par lal kapda bichhayein.
3. Murti aur Yantra Sthapana: Ganesh ji, Lakshmi ji, Kuber ji aur Vyapar Vridhi Yantra sthapit karein.
4. Sankalp: Apne business ke naam aur unnati ka sankalp lein.
5. Ganesh Pujan: Pehle Vighnaharta Ganesh ji ki vidhivat puja karein.
6. Bahi-Khata Pujan: Apne account books, laptop, ya tijori par roil se swastik banayein aur pujan karein.
7. Lakshmi-Kuber Pujan: Kamalgatta mala aur lal pushp arpit karte hue Lakshmi aur Kuber ka aavahan karein.
8. Yantra Pujan: Vyapar Vridhi yantra ko panchamrit se snan kara ke tijori mein rakhein.
9. Bhog: Mithaai aur meve ka bhog lagayein.
10. Aarti aur Daan: Kapur se aarti karein, bahar bandanwar (toran) bandhein, aur pehle grahak (customer) ko bhejney ki prarthana karein.
mantras: Om Shreem Hreem Shreem Kamale Kamalalaye Praseed Praseed...
